# P10 optional local feedback and reproducible native delivery rehearsal

Implements the optional controller in [ADR-0044](../adr/0044-native-catalyst-settings-composition.md)
on the complete [native Catalyst composition](2026-09-14-catalyst-native-form.md).
Private experiment, not a sixth catalog adapter, certified target or consumer migration.
The source-native React reference and no-JavaScript HTTP path remain independent.

## Implemented and exercised

- Live 240-codepoint bio count/error without truncation or requests; country changes
  keep focus and require an explicit compatible region. Editing clears stale success.
- Pointer and keyboard Reset each restore all ten edited fields from the app-selected
  initial snapshot, not the current response draft, without a request or replaced node.
- Validate and Enter still submit ordinary HTTP. Go independently rejects invalid
  drafts, retains their values, and focuses the first correction. Nothing is saved.
- An escaped inert template supplies versioned bounded configuration. No inline script,
  eval, injected HTML, dependency or framework is required. Native routes emit neither
  configuration nor module and retain `script-src 'none'`; enhanced routes use `'self'`.
- Preflight rejects duplicate JSON members, invalid Unicode, oversized text, duplicate
  instance IDs and inconsistent option inventories before changing the native form.
  Marked invalid options remain distinct from canonical choices. Disposal restores
  complete native region groups while preserving the select node, value and focus.
- Two instances operate independently. Correction of unknown country/currency values
  permits disposal/remount even while their old invalid options remain in the DOM.

The first-party controller is 18,005 bytes (5,128 bytes in a local gzip calculation).
That is not whole-page transfer, served compression, latency or performance-budget proof.

## Other checks and remaining work

Five Node tests pass and are wired into `task check`; the entire maintainer gate was
not rerun. Final source-only race tests: `internal/designadapt` 28.413s,
`cmd/appkit-mcp` 22.956s; both packages pass `go vet`. Two final private replays pass
actual-source compilation, independent generated-module race tests, HTTP tests and
binary build. Missing private inputs remain skips, not source-only proof of fidelity.

The [September15 follow-up](2026-09-15-catalyst-recovery-zoom.md) adds actual200% zoom,
browser503 recovery and a new exact replay. Still open: physical input, complete
accessibility/contrast/performance matrix, full source-fidelity review, private export and
CLI/catalog exposure, vendor-upgrade replay and real-consumer integration. No consumer
files, dependencies, global configuration, commits, deployment or real data changed.
Counts remain439/657 compiler/DOM inputs, five catalogued typed adapters, zero certified.
G1–G6 remain active; Windows and CA/GGB remain owner-deferred.
